ACA and VMI are not fittings pure-plays but are relevant adjacent bill-of-materials suppliers through utility transmission, distribution, and substation structures.
HUBB is a diversified reference leader, not the main underfollowed alpha candidate; use it for benchmark margins, order commentary, and competitive context.

Need a separate private-competitor map for MacLean Power Systems, Sabre, Dis-Tran, Pelco, and other non-public transmission hardware or pole suppliers to assess scarcity of investable public exposure.

The node may split into two investable subnodes: conductor/fitting/accessory hardware led by PLPC/HUBB, and transmission/substation structures led by ACA/VMI. Later layers should score these separately because margins, capacity constraints, and customer approval cycles may differ.

node: Transmission-line hardware, fittings, conductor accessories, and installation-specific components
summary: Layer 1B expanded the direct public-company universe around transmission-line physical bill-of-materials. The clearest underfollowed direct exposure is PLPC, a small-cap pure-play-ish manufacturer of energy and communications network hardware. Adjacent small/mid-cap discovery names include ACA and VMI through utility transmission, distribution, and substation structures rather than fittings. HUBB is included as a diversified reference leader because its Utility Solutions segment directly addresses utility transmission, distribution, and substation markets, but it is not a pure-play.
